blocks.title: Let's Sing!
blocks.body: Are you ready to sing Row, Row, Row Your Boat? It is one of the most fun songs!

blocks.title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat
blocks.content:
Row, row, row your boat,
Gently down the stream.

blocks.title: For Parents & Teachers
blocks.content: Encourage the child to do the hand actions while singing this rhyme to build motor skills.
